description: Validates a Claude Code hooks block (or a whole settings.json): events, matchers, hook types, timeouts and risky commands. Returns { ok, events, hookCount, findings[{ severity: error|warning|info, code, path, message }] and counts { error, warning, info } }. Price: 2 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

config.description: The config as a JSON string (comments and trailing commas allowed) or as an object, up to 60,000 characters.
